format: Bias layout's block edit for the XPROG ground strap, variant D (strap/GROUND.md). Applied by scripts/strap_patch.py before the layout stream's strap file. 'remove': [layer, x0, y0, x1, y1, cell, note], an existing box in that cell equal to the rectangle (exactly one; the cell has one instance). 'add': [layer, x0, y0, x1, y1, note], a rectangle added to the top cell. Chip um. Layers: met1 68/20, via 68/44, met2 69/20, via2 69/44, met3 70/20, via3 70/44, met4 71/20.

D: the block's one tie to the reference: via1 from the writers' metal-1 rail up to the pin's metal-2 pad
via2 from that pad up to the metal-3 pad on the buffer plate; the metal-3 pad and its 'vss' label stay, now the buffer plate's metal
the metal-2 pad between the two cuts, which would float without them

B second cuts inside the block: via
plate A's tie to the writers' rail: second via1, 0.19 um east of the existing one
met2
plate A's tie: metal-2 pad widened east over the second via1 and via2 (0.31 um from the vdd rail above)
via2
plate A's tie: second via2, 0.20 um east of the existing one
met3
plate A's tie: metal 3 widened east over the second via2; merges with the tie and plate A, more than 1.9 um from capacitor A's top plate, no edge facing it
met1
XPROG1's source: metal 1 widened east to 278.71 over the second via1, as it already is at the first (y 10.19-10.61); 0.168 um from the gate strap, as the source strip already is
via
XPROG1's source: second via1, 0.17 um above the existing one
met2
XPROG1's source: metal-2 pad extended up over the second via1 and via2
via2
XPROG1's source: second via2 onto plate A, 0.20 um above the existing one, 0.42 um from capacitor A's top plate
via
XPROG2's source: second via1, 0.17 um above the existing one, inside its metal-1 pad (283.78-284.31 x 9.06-10.06)
met2
